ns2:course.label: Power and Empowerment
ns2:course.description: Focus on different forms and understandings of power and empowerment over time. As practices and understandings of power change, perspectives on and strategies for empowerment change likewise. Since empowerment is central to current social thinking a critical understanding of empowerment is crucial. The approach is historical, comparative and transnational. By examining theories of collective action the course provides analytical foundation and depth to understanding social change. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: SOC 100.
